desc.p: The user creates a geocache they own. The rules are those of the website's "hide a cache" form, including its choices for publishing (publish), its date rules and its refusal of a second active cache at the same coordinates.
A geocache that is not published yet can't be read through OKAPI (like any unpublished geocache); cache_code and url point to it on the website.
This method is only available on installations that support cache editing. Check the has_cache_editing field in services/apisrv/installation before calling it.

req.name: cache_name
req.p: Name of the geocache. Must not be empty.

req.name: cache_type
req.p: One of the cache types of services/caches/geocache's type field that this installation supports (see cache_types in services/apisrv/installation).

req.name: longitude
req.p: Longitude of the geocache, -180 to 180. 0|0 is refused.

req.name: size2
req.p: Container size, as in the size2 field of services/caches/geocache: none, nano, micro, small, regular, large, xlarge or other.

opt.name: short_description
opt.p: One line shown above the description, plain text only.

opt.name: description
opt.p: The description, in the format given by description_format. Smileys such as :-) are stored as typed; the website shows them as images. Images can't be uploaded with the description.

opt.name: description_format

ul.li: plaintext - shown as written: HTML special characters are escaped, line breaks are kept;
html - cleaned by the website's own HTML purifier, the same one the website uses for descriptions written in its editor.

opt.p: Both are stored as HTML, as every description the website writes.

opt.name: desc_lang
opt.p: Language of the description, a two-letter code. A geocache is created with one description language; further languages are added on the website.

opt.name: country
opt.p: Two-letter country code. Mandatory if the user's profile has no country.

opt.name: date_hidden
opt.p: Date the cache was hidden, e.g. 2026-10-20; for events, the event date. As on the website, unless publish is notnow: a geocache must be hidden by the time it is published (with now: today at the latest), and an event must take place after it is published (with now: tomorrow at the earliest).

opt.name: publish
opt.p: When the geocache is published, as on the website:

ul.li: now - published at once, as Available;
later - published by the website at activate_on, activate_hour;
notnow - not published; the owner publishes it later on the website.

opt.name: activate_on
opt.p: With publish=later (and then mandatory): the day of publication, e.g. 2026-11-01, in the installation's time zone.

opt.name: activate_hour
opt.p: With publish=later: the full hour of publication, 0 to 23.

opt.name: passwd
opt.p: Log password: if given, "Found it" log entries need it (see services/caches/edit, which changes it later).

opt.name: alt_wpts
opt.p: JSON array of additional waypoints, each an object with location ("lat|lon"), type (parking, stage, path, final or poi; the aliases physical-stage, virtual-stage and trailhead are accepted) and an optional plain-text description. Names are given by the installation, as in the alt_wpts field of services/caches/geocache.

ul.li: cache_code - code of the new geocache,
url - its page on the website.
